_comment: Armband colours (#447): everyone wears a coloured band on both upper arms so you can tell who is who in a fight. players: co-op players (you and your friends); civilians; enemies: soldiers with no faction, and any faction not listed under factions; factions: a colour per soldier faction id (modules/factions/data/factions.json). Colours are [r, g, b] from 0 to 1. glow: how much the band lights itself so it still reads at night (0 none; past about 1 it starts to bloom like a lamp).
